mapName: Riftcap isolated spell and collision fixture (requires generated asset)

buttons.label: bolt
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'riftcap-main') { actor.testCast('bolt', 'riftcap-royal'); } }

buttons.label: swap
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'riftcap-main') { actor.testCast('swap', 'riftcap-ally'); } }

buttons.label: heal
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'riftcap-main') { actor.testCast('heal', 'riftcap-ally'); } }

buttons.label: ward
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'riftcap-main') { actor.testCast('ward', 'riftcap-ally'); } }

buttons.label: shatter
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'riftcap-main') { actor.testCast('shatter', 'riftcap-ally'); } }

buttons.label: time_bubble
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'riftcap-main') { actor.testCast('time_bubble', 'riftcap-ally'); } }

buttons.label: Wound ally
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'riftcap-ally') actor.receiveDamage(40); }

buttons.label: Bell interrupt
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'riftcap-main') { actor.onBellRung({eventId: performance.now()}); } }

buttons.label: Stun
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'riftcap-main') { actor.applyStatus('stun', {duration:2}); } }

buttons.label: Kill caster
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'riftcap-main') { actor.receiveDamage(9999); } }

buttons.label: Carry
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'riftcap-main') { actor.beginCarry(actor.runtime.getHero()); } }

buttons.label: Throw
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'riftcap-main') { actor.launch({velocity:{x:2,y:5,z:1}}); } }

buttons.label: Previous clip
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'riftcap-main') { actor.testCycleClip(-1); } }

buttons.label: Next clip
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'riftcap-main') { actor.testCycleClip(1); } }

buttons.label: Pursue royal
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'riftcap-main') { actor.testPaused=false; actor.behavior.changeTo('RiftcapPursueState'); } }

buttons.label: Pause pursuit
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'riftcap-main') { actor.testPaused=true; actor.behavior.changeTo('RiftcapPursueState'); } }

buttons.label: Gate swap setup
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if(actor.definition?.id==='riftcap-main') actor.entity.rigidbody.teleport(0,2.014,-7.2); if(actor.definition?.id==='riftcap-ally') actor.entity.rigidbody.teleport(0,2.014,-4.8); if(actor.definition?.id==='entrance-castle') actor.testEntranceOpenAmount=0; }

buttons.label: Open gate
buttons.script: for (const castle of objects.getAll('castle')) castle.testEntranceOpenAmount=1;

buttons.label: Close gate
buttons.script: for (const castle of objects.getAll('castle')) castle.testEntranceOpenAmount=0;

buttons.label: Spell view
buttons.script: camera.setViewport({zoom:4.5,rotation:2,panX:0,panZ:-12});

buttons.label: Gate view
buttons.script: camera.setViewport({zoom:4.5,rotation:2,panX:0,panZ:-6});

buttons.label: Verify every clip
buttons.script: for(const actor of objects){if(actor.definition?.id==='riftcap-main'){actor.checks.verifyClips();}}

buttons.label: Transparent preview
buttons.script: for(const actor of objects){if(actor.definition?.id==='riftcap-main'){actor.testPlayClip('idle');actor.capturePreview();}}
